what: Every C# colour literal in runtime code that never reaches a pixel or is already painted from the colour set, read with Roslyn's semantic model on 2026-11-10 (all three builds: release, development, editor) and checked against every prefab, scene and asset that holds the script. colour_trace.py reads it: a literal it lists by file, literal and line (within 60 lines) takes its bucket; a literal it does not list is untraced until it is read through ColorTrace or added here with its reason. Fields (a serialized colour in an asset, by asset and field path) take INERT or FALLBACK the same way. Buckets: INERT (never drawn: a serialized default every instance overrides, an alpha-0 sentinel, a value overwritten before it draws), FALLBACK (drawn only when a reference is unwired, which no shipped scene leaves unwired), EXCLUDED (editor-only, development-build-only, gizmo, debug or a diagnostic tool), TRACED (another path paints it from the worn set first).

fields.why: A legacy-panel colour that DisconnectNotice uses only when WindowPrefab is empty, which the shipped asset never leaves it (it wires DisconnectNoticeView.prefab).
Only DisconnectNotice.BuildUI's legacy panel paints it, and that panel is built only when the config's WindowPrefab is empty; the shipped Resources asset wires DisconnectNoticeView.prefab.
The legacy panel's Reconnect fill, built only when WindowPrefab is empty; the shipped asset wires the style-B window.
The legacy panel's Continue Offline fill, built only when WindowPrefab is empty; the shipped asset wires the style-B window.
Drawn only as the replay's dark-stage camera clear (TheaterStage.Enter -> HideWorld), which shows only when the replay's arena cannot be stood; the shipped asset has hideWorld off.

Shown only on the single-icon joust path or when ElementalBarsConfig fails to load; the shipped prefab wires both hull icons and the config exists, so a joust flashes ElementalBarsConfig's lime instead.

Only partly: the field is declared and read in the base class ToyDefinitionSO (outside this batch), and ToyboxCard.Bind paints the Vessel Changer card's accentFill from ToyDefinitionSO.AccentColor, which UIThemeLive retraces by value only at a wear or a canvas sweep, so a pooled card re-bound after a wear shows the authored gold (ToyConfigureModal's back row and VesselChangerToy.PreviewColor reach it only as fallbacks).
Used only when the vessel has no domain palette to read the ready colour from, which no shipped hull lacks.

Its only paint is inside UpdateView's loop over sortedCaptains, a private list that is only ever cleared (AssignModel: the captain system was removed), so the loop never runs and the colour never reaches a pixel.
The weekly-challenge modal's tab colours are overwritten by its kit tabs before they draw (the migration review of WeeklyChallengeLeaderboardModal, 2026-11-10).
